rationale: The evaluator feedback on the previous candidate suggested that further reducing the proportional gain (kp) and increasing the derivative gain (kd) could help reduce residual oscillations. The base speed was recommended to be slightly lowered if progress is low but stable to improve control. Based on this, I have reduced kp from 6 to 5 to further decrease the proportional response and potential overshoot. I increased kd from 6 to 7 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations. The base speed is lowered from 1.5 to 1.4 to balance speed and control stability, aiming to maintain progress while reducing instability. The integral gain ki remains at 0.5 to preserve integral action, and sensor weights and line loss strategy remain unchanged as no issues were reported with them. I expect these changes to reduce steering oscillations further, improve stability, and maintain or slightly improve progress. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects in the next race.
